label: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R PC (JJASBR.exe)
note: Partial set, high confidence only. Self-named: task-registration and constructor strings in this exe. Others: matched against eight Storm reference builds (Storm 1, 2, 3 HD, 4 release and debug, Revolution, Connections, Switch Trilogy) by unique shared strings, BSim and call graph, then voted; a name is kept only if it rests on a shared string, BSim agreement across 2+ builds, or a BSim match on a function of 64+ bytes whose class is shared engine/library code or exists in this exe's own source-file list. Names of Naruto-only classes, constructors/destructors without a string anchor, and names from libraries this exe does not link (Bullet, tolua++, libc++) are dropped. Blind review of an 80-name held-out sample: 90% correct.
